claims.text: US President Donald Trump unveiled a new helipad on the White House South Lawn and cut a ribbon leading to it on Monday.
Donald Trump was barely audible during live broadcast of the helipad event because Marine One drowned out his voice and standard TV pool microphones were absent.
The White House TV press pool comprises five major networks: ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox News, and NBC.
The five TV pool networks suspended pooled broadcast coverage of President Trump after he banned CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from White House grounds.

The five TV networks stated jointly: 'The public has a vital interest in receiving accurate, independent information about its government. No administration should restrict a news organisation because it objects to its reporting.'
C-SPAN declined to broadcast the White House helipad ceremony because it relies on the TV pool feed.
The White House launched 'Trump TV', a 24/7 streaming platform featuring administration announcements, presidential speeches, and coverage related to Donald Trump.
'Trump TV' began its initial broadcast by streaming Donald Trump's July 3 address at Mount Rushmore on the White House YouTube channel.
CNN, Politico, and MS NOW filed an emergency First Amendment lawsuit in DC District Court seeking to restore their White House press credentials.
CNN, Politico, and MS NOW stated in their lawsuit: 'This ban could not be a more direct assault on the First Amendment nor a more blatant violation of our most fundamental constitutional principles.'
Donald Trump defended the restrictions on CNN, Politico, and MS NOW, stating that news outlets accused of publishing 'fake news' have no constitutional right to White House grounds access.

Donald Trump said outside Gracie Mansion regarding press boycott threats: 'They said they were going to boycott me, but they never boycott me. So I wasn't very worried about that. Look at all that press.'
US District Judge Tim Kelly was assigned to preside over the First Amendment lawsuit brought by CNN, MS NOW, and Politico against the Trump administration.
Judge Tim Kelly previously ordered the Trump administration to restore White House credentials for CNN journalist Jim Acosta in 2018.
News outlets including the New York Times and Washington Post delayed publishing still photographs from White House pool coverage until midnight in solidarity with barred outlets.
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani expressed disagreement with Donald Trump's press ban and welcomed all journalists onto the lawn at Gracie Mansion.
Donald Trump announced the White House ban on CNN, Politico, and MS NOW on Friday, accusing them of writing 'fiction or lies'.
Fox News Washington bureau chief Bryan Boughton notified newsrooms that the TV pool would stop providing designated pool coverage for President Trump starting Monday.
On Monday, the five-seat CNN booth in the White House press basement was left empty and powered off, forcing CNN reporters to broadcast live from a public sidewalk outside.
Conservative news outlet Real America's Voice was listed as the secondary press crew for Donald Trump's trip to New York.
Houthi forces battled Saudi-backed Yemeni government troops on Monday for control of the strategic Kahboub Mountains in Taiz and Lahj provinces.
The Kahboub Mountains overlook the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Mayyun Island in the Red Sea.
The New York Times reported that President Donald Trump ordered air strikes against the Houthis on Sunday but cancelled them at the last minute.
Fighting in Yemen since August 6 has killed at least 674 people and displaced more than 158,000 individuals, according to Yemeni officials and the World Health Organization.
Houthi leader Abdel-Malik al-Houthi stated in an address that the US was considering joint military escalation with Saudi Arabia against Houthi forces.
Yemeni government forces chief of staff Major-General Abdulaziz al-Majidi stated that soldiers and tribal allies liberated several areas on the outskirts of Taiz.
Houthi-affiliated Al Masirah TV reported a late Monday strike in Mocha killed six civilians, including two children and a woman.
More than 18 million people in Yemen currently face acute food insecurity, according to the World Food Programme.
Brent crude rose 0.51% to $100.80 per barrel and US West Texas Intermediate crude rose 0.43% to $92.77 per barrel on Tuesday.
Houthi forces claimed responsibility for attacks targeting Riyadh and a Saudi Aramco facility in Yanbu.
Only 12 commodity vessels passed through the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend compared to 35 vessels during the previous weekend.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned that foreign companies servicing Iranian airlines could face secondary sanctions starting September 23.
UKMTO reported that an outbound LPG tanker and another vessel were struck by projectiles or debris in the Strait of Hormuz, causing minor crew injuries on one vessel.
The Trump administration proposed a $5 billion fund to rebuild Middle Eastern energy infrastructure and bypass reliance on the Strait of Hormuz.
President Donald Trump held a phone conversation with Yemeni President Rashad al-Alimi regarding Houthi advances near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
G7 foreign ministers released a joint statement calling on Iran to end its military support for Houthi forces in Yemen.
UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced that the UK agreed to supply defensive air-to-air refuelling via an RAF Voyager for Saudi Arabian jets.
UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated he will ask US President Donald Trump to de-escalate the conflict in Iran during their Tuesday meeting.
The UK and US militaries recently tested an Excalibur drone in British waters, launching a heavyweight torpedo designed to sink ships and submarines.
Approximately 130 heads of state and government are scheduled to address the 81st session of the UN General Assembly starting Tuesday.
US President Donald Trump and French President Emmanuel Macron are scheduled to address the UN General Assembly on Tuesday following UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian are scheduled to address the UN General Assembly on Wednesday.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly in person on Thursday.
Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas will address the UN General Assembly by video on Thursday after being denied a US visa.
Chinese President Xi Jinping is skipping the UN General Assembly to meet Donald Trump in Washington on Wednesday, sending a vice president to New York instead.
Russian President Vladimir Putin and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi are not attending the 81st UN General Assembly session.
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres' second five-year term ends on December 31.
The theme for the 81st UN General Assembly General Debate is 'Restoring trust, managing transformation: a United Nations that delivers for all'.
Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar is leading the Indian delegation and will address the UN General Assembly on September 26.
Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is scheduled to speak second at the UN General Assembly opening on Tuesday morning, followed by President Donald Trump.
President Donald Trump announced plans on Truth Social for a proposed 250-foot military arch in Washington, D.C., equipped with sniper positions and weaponry.
The Federal Aviation Administration is preparing an $875 million AI-powered software overhaul called SMART to streamline air traffic control.

The US Department of Homeland Security launched an investigation after a federal immigration officer shot and injured 28-year-old Venezuelan citizen Wilber Rafael Garces Perez during an operation in Austin, Texas.
